question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The historian examined the **manuscript **carefully.

options.text: The writer finished the manuscript early.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"manuscript"** means a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's draft before it is published. (पांडुलिपि)

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient manuscript was preserved in a glass case in the museum.
 
 
 
• **"Manuscripted"** is a verb form of the word "manuscript" (though less common), implying the act of creating or drafting a manuscript. (पांडुलिपि तैयार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The author manuscripted his book within a year.
 
 
 
• In the context of the options provided, the sentence in Option 2 uses a form of the word "manuscript" that matches the homonym of the highlighted word in the question sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: The writer finished the manuscript early. **(लेखक ने पांडुलिपि जल्दी पूरी की।)

 
 
• This sentence simply uses the original meaning of "manuscript" as a draft or document, not the verb form.
 
• **Example:** The manuscript of the novel was submitted to the publisher.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: The editor revised the manuscript.** (संपादक ने पांडुलिपि को संशोधित किया।)
 
 
• This sentence also uses "manuscript" in its noun form and does not demonstrate the homonym.
 
• **Example:** The editor found several errors in the manuscript.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The artist painted a manuscript.** (कलाकार ने एक पांडुलिपि को चित्रित किया।)
 
 
• This sentence incorrectly associates "manuscript" with painting, as manuscripts are not typically painted.
 
• **Example:** The artist provided illustrations for the manuscript, but did not paint it.
 
 

3c:Tda2,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
